_comment: Photos on /agency-fam-trip-2027/. To swap a photo: run python3 tools/optimize_fam_trip_images.py SOURCE.png (writes assets/img/fam-trip/<name>.webp and <name>-640.webp), then point that slot's 'src' at the path without the extension and set width/height to the printed full-size values and a truthful 'alt'. 'label' is 'previous' (our own delivered project) or 'illustrative' (stock or marketing image that is NOT one of our projects); every image shows a badge for it. 'pos' is the CSS object-position used when the photo is cropped. Keep every image different (no repeats), describe only what the photo shows and never name a hotel as part of the programme; hotels and venues are not yet confirmed. Run python3 tools/fam_trip_build.py afterwards. Spare (not used on the page): /assets/img/fam-trip/antalya-mice-networking-event (+ -640), a networking-on-a-yacht-deck photo (illustrative).
